text:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — launch commitment gate tomorrow 2pm. Need to decide: lock MVP cuts for GA or accept a 2-week milestone reset. Customer pilot expects tenant-level routing in MVP.
Sam (Eng): Can we scope tenant routing as a v1 add-on? It touches routing policy + dedicated pools.
Liam (Customer Success): Pilot customer (Acme Health) said tenant routing is a hard requirement for pilot rollout, otherwise they won't sign the pilot SOW.
Priya (Design): If we punt tenant routing to v1, we should ship strong UX hints and admin toggles so customers don't feel blocked.
Rohit (SRE): FYI tenant routing increases infra surface area (cross-tenant KV isolation). Short-term risk: higher p50 tail unless we add stricter autoscaling.
Ava (PM): Options on the table: (A) lock MVP as-is, push pilot to after GA; (B) pull tenant routing into MVP and accept a 2-week delay + extra SRE work; (C) soft-ship MVP + feature-flagged tenant routing for pilot only. Thoughts?
Sam (Eng): (C) seems doable engineering-wise if we isolate pilot traffic to a dedicated pool and use a feature flag + rollout policy. Will need a small infra carve-out and one extra sprint for integration tests.
Rohit (SRE): Dedicated pool is safest. We can carve one small pool but SLA will differ. Also need an emergency fallback policy to default routing if the pool saturates.
Liam (Customer Success): Pilot customer is okay with an initial dedicated pool and different SLA as long as scope is explicit in the SOW. They want go/no-go within 48h post-gate.
Priya (Design): UX for admin toggles + pilot onboarding checklist — I can deliver mocks by EOD today if we commit.
Ava (PM): Proposal: choose (C) and set these acceptance criteria for the gate: 1) infra carve-out PR merged, 2) feature flag + admin toggle in console, 3) pilot SOW wording confirmed, 4) canary plan and rollback documented. If any of the four fails, we fallback to (A) and reset milestone.
Sam (Eng): I'll own infra carve-out PR and the canary/rollback plan. ETA: +3 business days if we prioritize.
Rohit (SRE): I'll document autoscaling and fallback steps. Need at least one dry-run of scale test before gate.
Liam (Customer Success): I'll update SOW language and coordinate sign-off with Acme.
Priya (Design): On it for mocks and onboarding checklist.
Ava (PM): OK — action items noted. If we all hit criteria then gate vote tomorrow 2pm. If not, we'll declare a 2-week milestone reset and ship MVP without tenant routing.
deploy-bot: Build pipeline for infra-carveout triggered by branch: feature/tenant-pilot — build started (id: build-4923).
Sam (Eng): seeing build started, I'll watch and push fixes if needed.
Ava (PM): Thanks all — short stand at 1:30 to surface blockers before the gate. :thumbsup:
Liam (Customer Success): Adding Acme's legal contact to the thread for SOW confirmation: @jordan.
Sam (Eng): quick note — if we choose (C) we should also add a telemetry flag to track pilot error rates separately.
Rohit (SRE): Agreed. Add a dashboard for pilot pool latency and error budget burn.
Ava (PM): I'll create the gate checklist doc and share the link here before 1:15.
